-- Diagnostic command for LSP
function _G.LspDebugInfo()
  print("Current filetype: " .. vim.bo.filetype)
  local clients = vim.lsp.get_clients()
  if #clients == 0 then
    print("No active LSP clients.")
  else
    print("Active LSP clients:")
    for _, client in ipairs(clients) do
      print("- " .. client.name .. " (id: " .. client.id .. ")")
    end
  end
end

  local lang = 'py'

  vim.api.nvim_set_current_line(new_line)

  pattern = "*.py",

})

}

  pattern = 'nix',

    vim.lsp.start({ name = 'nixd', cmd = { 'nixd' } })
  end,
})

Nixvim uses a modular system for managing Neovim plugins, where each supported plugin has its own Nix module. To enable a plugin, you set its `enable` option to `true` within the `programs.nixvim.plugins` attribute set. 

## Enabling Plugin Modules

You can enable plugins by setting `programs.nixvim.plugins.<plugin-name>.enable = true;` in your Nix configuration. 

For the plugins you listed, here's how you would enable them:

*   `bufferline`: Set `programs.nixvim.plugins.bufferline.enable = true;`. 
*   `dashboard`: Set `programs.nixvim.plugins.dashboard.enable = true;`. 
*   `mini`: Set `programs.nixvim.plugins.mini.enable = true;`.  This plugin is a collection of modules, and you can enable specific mini modules via `programs.nixvim.plugins.mini.modules.<module-name> = { ... };`. 
*   `todo-comments`: Set `programs.nixvim.plugins.todo-comments.enable = true;`. 
*   `which-key`: Set `programs.nixvim.plugins.which-key.enable = true;`. 

For plugins like `cellular-automaton`, `better-escape`, and `illuminate`, if they are not available as dedicated Nixvim modules, you would typically add them using the `extraPlugins` option. 

## Listing Available Plugin Modules

Nixvim's architecture includes a modular plugin registry located at `plugins/default.nix`.  The `example.nix` file also indicates that an up-to-date list of available plugins can be found in the Nixvim documentation.

For plugins not explicitly listed as modules, the `extraPlugins` option is the recommended way to include them.
